_note: Verify each 'model' string against the provider's current model list before running -- these are placeholders and model IDs change independently of this config. Never put an API key value in this file; apiKeyEnvVar names the environment variable to read it from.
_note_maxTokens: 8192 was empirically confirmed too small 2026-08-01: every capability-synthesis and reduce call in the first building test run hit it and was silently truncated (fixed now to fail closed instead -- see llm-adapter.ts's stop_reason/finishReason checks and synthesis-orchestrator.ts's splitMarkedFiles). Raised to 16384 as a first re-tested guess, not a verified ceiling -- if a future call still throws LLM_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED, raise further and re-test rather than assuming this value is enough for every call shape.
_note_gemini: Gemini runs via Vertex AI (not the consumer Generative Language API), authenticated with ADC ('gcloud auth application-default login') rather than an API key -- reflects SSO/enterprise access, no apiKeyEnvVar needed or used for this provider. projectId/location verified working 2026-08-01 against dev-oskey-io under identity david.openshaw@oskey.io; us-central1 also confirmed working as a fallback if europe-west1 has an outage or access issue.

gemini-default._note: Temporarily on gemini-2.5-pro -- gemini-3.6-flash returned HTTP 404 'not found or your project does not have access to it' on this exact Vertex AI endpoint/project/region (2026-08-01). Error's own doc link pointed at gemini-enterprise-agent-platform, not classic Vertex AI, suggesting 3.6-flash may need a different product surface or explicit enablement. Not yet investigated further.

claude-default._note: No 'temperature' here deliberately -- claude-sonnet-5 rejects the request outright if it's present at all (HTTP 400 'temperature is deprecated for this model'), confirmed 2026-08-01. The adapter omits it entirely for Anthropic; leaving a value here would misleadingly imply it's respected.
